spans.s:
a-daṃṣṭrin, a. without tusks or large
teeth.

adás [501], pron. yon, yonder, that, that
there, in opposition to the one here or just
mentioned: e. g. asau, 22^7, that one (the
traveller--last mentioned at 20^19); so 31^10;
asāv amutra, ayam asmin, that one in
that world, this one in this, 103^7; that one
(correl. ya), 7^6, 37^11; as designation of persons
not to be named, so-and-so, N. or M.;
[]
asāv aham, I am so-and-so, 61^14; 60^21;
103^5; follows at a distance the word to
which it refers, thus emphasizing it, 23^1.
[see 501 and 503.]

ādara, m. respect, notice, care. [√2dṛ +
ā, ‘regard.’]

ādáhana, n. burning-place, place of cremation.
 [√dah + ā.]
